# Truthsocial (3 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /profile | `handle` | 1 | Get Truth Social user profile |
| /user/posts | `handle` / `user_id` | 1 | List Truth Social user posts |
| /post | `url` | 1 | Get Truth Social post details |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /profile — 1cr

Returns public profile information for a Truth Social user including display name, follower count, following count, truth count, bio, and profile image URL.

**Parameters**

- `handle`: Truth Social username without the @ symbol

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/truthsocial/profile?handle=<handle>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /user/posts — 1cr

Returns a list of recent truths posted by a Truth Social user. Each truth includes the text content, like count, retruth count, reply count, media attachments, and creation timestamp.

**Parameters**

- `next_max_id` *(optional)*: Used to paginate to next page Native upstream cursor param. Send the universal `cursor` instead — the API maps it to this name for you.
- `trim` *(optional)*: Set to true for a trimmed down version of the response
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Universal pagination cursor. Send `pagination.next_cursor` from the previous response back verbatim — the API maps it to this endpoint's native `next_max_id` (cursor style). You never construct, decode, or look up a cursor. Omit it for page 1.
- `handle` / `user_id` — at least one required.
  - `handle`: Truth Social username without the @ symbol (one of: handle, user_id — at least one required)
  - `user_id`: Truth Social user id. Use this for faster response times. Trumps is 107780257626128497. It is the 'id' field in the profile endpoint. (one of: handle, user_id — at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/truthsocial/user/posts?handle=<handle>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /post — 1cr

Returns detailed information about a specific Truth Social post including the text content, like count, retruth count, reply count, media attachments, author info, and creation timestamp.

**Parameters**

- `url`: Full URL of the Truth Social post

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/truthsocial/post?url=<url>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```


## Choosing a Truth Social endpoint

| Your goal | Use this | Credits |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| A profile | `/profile` | 1 |
| Their posts | `/user/posts` | 1 |
| One post | `/post` | 1 |

All 1 credit, no search — bring the handle with you.

`prism/truthsocial-pulse` (20cr) is the composite: profile, recent posts, per-post detail drill
and the surrounding news echo in one call. Three 1cr calls cover the raw data; pay the 20cr
only when you want the news reaction folded in. `prism/voice` (5cr) merges a person's posts
here with X, Threads and Bluesky into one time-ordered feed.

## Field Maps


The `profile` endpoint returns an `Author` response normalized by the `truthsocial-author` field map, and `post` returns a `Post` normalized by `truthsocial-post`. Both include computed fields under `data.computed`. Use `?format=raw` to bypass both.
